UnitStatement: Harness Validation Suite

The Harness Validation Suite validates the harness runtime contract for session lifecycle, turn execution, SSE streaming, options fallback resolution, subagent governance gates, and attachment behavior.
The `npm run harness:validate:section8` script executes `frontend/scripts/validate-harness-section8.mjs`.
The section8 validator emits machine-readable lines `HARNESS_VALIDATION_SUMMARY_PATH=<path>` and `HARNESS_VALIDATION_STATUS=pass|fail`.
The `npm run harness:validate:premerge` script executes the section8 validator and enforces required test IDs.
The premerge script copies the validation summary to `frontend/artifacts/harness/section8/latest/summary.json`.
Running the harness validation suite requires Node.js version `>=20`.
Running the harness validation suite requires frontend dependencies installed in `frontend/`.
The Harness API must be reachable at `HARNESS_BASE_URL`, which defaults to `http://127.0.0.1:3000`.
A valid working root must be configured via `HARNESS_PROJECT_ROOT`; the recommended value is `examples/example-project`.
If `HARNESS_PROJECT_ROOT` points inside the instruction root, the section8 validator auto-stages it to a temp external workroot to satisfy the `WORKING_ROOT_CONFLICT` policy.
Local runs are executed from the `frontend/` directory.
A local run executes `npm run harness:validate:section8` followed by `npm run harness:validate:premerge`.
Optional environment overrides for a local run include `HARNESS_BASE_URL` and `HARNESS_PROJECT_ROOT` set before `npm run harness:validate:premerge`.
For CI integration, run the validator in a headless step after the harness API surface is available.
The CI step runs `npm ci` in the `frontend` directory before invoking the premerge validator.
The CI step sets `HARNESS_BASE_URL` and `HARNESS_PROJECT_ROOT=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/examples/example-project` before `npm run harness:validate:premerge`.
The pipeline must fail when the validation command exit code is non-zero.
Live run outputs are written to `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/chirality-harness-validation/latest/`.
The stable premerge summary is located at `frontend/artifacts/harness/section8/latest/summary.json`.
The instruction-root integrity summary is located at `frontend/artifacts/harness/instruction-root-integrity/latest/summary.json`.
The repeatability check runs `npm run harness:validate:premerge` twice against the same harness state and confirms the results.
For repeatability, both runs must exit `0`.
For repeatability, both summaries must report `"status": "pass"`.
For repeatability, the required test IDs must be unchanged between runs.
